$comment: GUARD:HELD-ROWS (HOS-2179 D1, scripts/check-held-payment-readers.ts). Readers of payments.addonInstanceId that deliberately do NOT tell a mark-held page-charge row from the purchase's payment. Each needs a reason and the exact count of its reads ("readers"), so a new read fails until reviewed; an entry that matches no reader fails the guard.

readers.reason: Page-payments sweep: it only collects the charge ids that already have a row so it does not re-decide them. A held row must be skipped exactly like an activation row.
Notice routing: it finds the row of the notified charge to run RF3 on it. A held row is refunded through that same path (D1), so it must be found.
Chargeback check: it looks up the row of one charge by id. For a held row the naming mark is found and the chargeback is noted on it instead of opening CONTRACARGO.
Chargeback check listing: rows are listed only to be re-read for a chargeback, never credited or moved. A held row must be re-read too. packages/db cannot import the service-core predicate.
Reads held rows on purpose: it joins the row to its open page-charge mark through reconciliation_mark_payment, which is what makes it held.
Refund: it reads the column of the payment a given refund already names, only to classify the subject. It never chooses a payment.
